page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn8v.4xlarge is an x86_64 GPU-accelerated compute instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It is provisioned with 16 dedicated vCPUs sourced from an Intel Xeon 8469C processor running at a base clock speed of 2.6 GHz. Memory capacity is configured at 96.0 GB, providing an allocation ratio of 6.0 GB per vCPU core.

Hardware acceleration is supplied by a single GPU provisioned with 96 GB of total VRAM, matching the host system's system memory capacity. The instance includes a baseline network throughput of 12 Gbps. It features no integrated local storage and includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, necessitating external network-attached block storage and allocated IP resources for persistent operations.

Given the high GPU memory ceiling coupled with 16 dedicated host cores, ecs.gn8v.4xlarge functions primarily for accelerated workloads such as large language model inference, machine learning model fine-tuning, scientific computing simulations, and data-intensive graphic processing tasks.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn8v.4xlarge is a dedicated GPU-accelerated cloud instance powered by the KVM hypervisor on an x86_64 architecture. Compute is handled by 16 dedicated vCPUs from an Intel Xeon 8469C processor operating at 2.6 GHz, coupled with 96.0 GB of system RAM. Hardware acceleration is provided by a single GPU with 96 GB of VRAM. The server delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 12 Gbps. It does not include local disk storage or complimentary public IPv4 addresses, requiring cloud block storage for file systems. With a 1:1 ratio between system memory and GPU VRAM alongside dedicated compute cores, this instance is suited for GPU-intensive workloads such as deep learning inference, model training, parallel compute simulations, and heavy computational rendering pipelines.
